explanation: In repo mode, syncBundle gathers every out-of-date template that renders, ships them in one CommitFiles call (one commit) and builds a PR body with one SYNCPR-003 section per member. Render failures and section overlaps are excluded and reported, and unchanged bundles are skipped. Tests cover these behaviours.

evidence.excerpt: err := s.ghClient.Repos.CommitFiles(ctx, owner, repo, branch, head, files, bundleMessage(s.commitPrefix(), members))
members = append(members, bundleMember{tmpl: tmpl, r: r})
